name: How do I know if my wall can be patched or if it needs replacement?
description: Small, dry, solid damage can usually be patched. Soft, stained, sagging, or crumbling drywall often needs more than a patch.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my wall can be patched or if it needs replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tiny nail holes and hairline dents are usually simple patch jobs. If the drywall is soft, crumbling, stained, sagging, or the hole is larger than a few inches, it often needs more than a cosmetic patch and may require section replacement or a moisture fix first.
